mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the handle was most worthwhile because the assembled parts became a recognizable pinwheel.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated corner folds were the least engaging passage, although they made the construction sequence easy to follow.

surprise.text: The folds becoming blades made the purpose of the paper clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed a stated construction goal.

continue.text: I would try another chapter to see a different toy come together, though I hope it offers more variety than the repeated folds.
